cut.v14-arros-9-by-terram: Cut: it was a one-venue rice lane ('Bistro & rice'), and tiny lanes are merged or cut; the city's rice is told by the old houses' daily arròs and by the chefs' lane. Nothing against it.
cut.v35-konig-2: Cut, told once: the same house as König on Carrer dels Calderers (kept in the late lane, the branch under Sant Feliu's steps with the later hours); two cards for one fast-food group was one too many.
cut.v10-nu: Cut after the 20 Oct re-check: the old record's Nu became Nexe in 2022, but no 2026 evidence of trading was found, one listing shows it 'temporarily closed', and neither its MICHELIN-selection claim, its Repsol 2026 mention nor its named chefs could be confirmed. A chefs' lane of two confirmed rooms beats three with a doubt.
cut.v34-cul-de-la-lleona: Cut after the 20 Oct re-check: the old record called it a Nepali kitchen rebadged 'x Catmandu', but the rebrand was found nowhere outside the old record, review sites still describe a tapas menu, nothing dated 2026 was found, and the record itself had no bylined review. Its lane ('the other kitchens') would have held one venue; Nomo, the confirmed one, joins the new rooms.
cut.v41-federal-cafe: Cut: the morning lane holds three and keeps the two that belong to Girona (the 1916 granja, the roadside fork breakfast) and the café the city's cycling scene grew out of; Federal is the Girona outpost of a Barcelona-born brunch group, and its own record carries three conflicting sets of hours.
